title: Admin - Edit Admin Permissions - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin User & Role Management - Edit Admin Permissions feature on the Y4J platform. This feature allows Super Admins to edit existing admin permissions by clicking 'Edit Permissions' on an admin card, which opens a permissions editor with pre-selected existing permissions. Admins can add/remove permissions and save changes that reflect immediately on the admin card. Edge cases include removing all permissions (blocked) and permission update failure (resets to old permissions).

testCases.title: Clicking 'Edit Permissions' opens the permissions editor
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded with at least one admin card that has an 'Edit Permissions' button.
steps: Locate an admin card with the 'Edit Permissions' button
expectedResults: A permissions editor (modal/panel) opens
The editor displays permission checkboxes
The editor is associated with the correct admin (shows admin name or context)
The editor has a Save button and a way to close/cancel
testCases.postconditions: Permissions editor is open for the selected admin

testCases.title: Existing permissions are pre-selected in the editor
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. An admin with permissions 'Dashboard', 'Partner Management', 'Product Management' exists.
steps: Find the admin card showing permissions: Dashboard, Partner Management, Product Management
Observe the checkbox states in the editor
expectedResults: 'Dashboard' checkbox is pre-checked
'Partner Management' checkbox is pre-checked
'Product Management' checkbox is pre-checked
All other permission checkboxes are unchecked
The pre-selected state matches exactly what is shown on the admin card

testCases.title: Admin can add new permissions
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Permissions editor is open for an admin with partial permissions.
steps: Open the permissions editor for an admin with 'Dashboard' and 'Partner Management' only
Check the 'Analytics' checkbox (adding a new permission)
expectedResults: The new checkboxes become checked when clicked
Save completes successfully
The admin card now shows 4 permissions: Dashboard, Partner Management, Analytics, Comment Moderation
A success notification may be displayed
testCases.postconditions: New permissions are added and visible on the admin card

testCases.title: Admin can remove existing permissions
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Permissions editor is open for an admin with multiple permissions.
steps: Open the permissions editor for an admin with 'Dashboard', 'Partner Management', 'Product Management'
Uncheck the 'Product Management' checkbox (removing a permission)
expectedResults: The 'Product Management' checkbox becomes unchecked
Save completes successfully
The admin card now shows only 2 permissions: Dashboard, Partner Management
'Product Management' is no longer displayed on the card
testCases.postconditions: Permission is removed and no longer visible on the admin card

testCases.title: Clicking Save updates permissions immediately
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Permissions editor is open with changes made.
steps: Observe the admin card immediately after save
expectedResults: The editor closes after successful save
The admin card updates immediately to reflect the new permissions
No page refresh is required
The updated permissions are visible as tags on the card
A success notification may appear
testCases.postconditions: Permissions are updated immediately on the admin card

testCases.title: Updated permissions reflect in admin card after save
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Permissions have just been updated for an admin.
expectedResults: Immediately after save: card shows updated permissions (Analytics present, Dashboard removed)
After page refresh: card still shows the same updated permissions
The change is persisted to the backend
The permissions count on the card matches the number of selected permissions
testCases.postconditions: Updated permissions persist across page refresh

testCases.title: Cannot save with all permissions removed - validation blocks save
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Permissions editor is open for an admin.
steps: Open the permissions editor for an admin with some permissions
expectedResults: The Save button is disabled OR clicking Save shows a validation error
Error message states: 'At least one permission must be selected' (or similar)
The editor remains open for the user to correct
No changes are saved to the backend
The admin card retains its original permissions
testCases.postconditions: Save is blocked when all permissions are removed

testCases.title: Permission update failure resets to old permissions
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Backend API is configured to fail on permission update.
steps: Open the permissions editor for an admin with 'Dashboard', 'Partner Management'
expectedResults: An error notification is displayed (e.g., 'Failed to update permissions. Reverting to previous settings.')
The permission checkboxes reset to the original state (Dashboard, Partner Management only)
The admin card still shows the original permissions (no change)
'Analytics' is NOT shown on the card
The user can retry the save
testCases.postconditions: Permissions revert to original state on API failure

testCases.title: Closing editor without saving discards changes
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Permissions editor is open with unsaved changes.
steps: Close the editor without clicking Save (click X, press Escape, or click outside)
expectedResults: The editor closes without saving
The admin card shows the original permissions (unchanged)
No changes are persisted to the backend
No error messages appear
Re-opening the editor shows the original pre-selected permissions
testCases.postconditions: Changes are discarded when editor is closed without saving

testCases.title: Edit Permissions button is present on every admin card
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Multiple admin cards are displayed.
steps: Observe each admin card in the list
Verify the 'Edit Permissions' button is present on each card
expectedResults: Every admin card (both Super Admin and Limited-Access Admin) has an 'Edit Permissions' button
The button text includes context (e.g., 'Edit permissions for IvAdmin1')
All buttons are clickable
testCases.postconditions: Edit Permissions button is confirmed on all cards

testCases.title: Editing Super Admin permissions shows all permissions pre-selected
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. A Super Admin card exists in the list.
expectedResults: All permission checkboxes are pre-checked (all 7-8 permissions selected)
This reflects the Super Admin's full access
Checkboxes may be editable or locked depending on implementation
testCases.postconditions: Super Admin shows all permissions pre-selected in editor

testCases.title: Save button is only enabled when changes are made
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Permissions editor is open with no changes made.
steps: Observe the Save button state again
expectedResults: With no changes: Save button may be disabled or clicking it does nothing
After making a change: Save button becomes enabled/active
OR Save is always enabled but shows 'No changes to save' if clicked without changes
testCases.postconditions: Save button state reflects whether changes exist

testCases.title: Multiple rapid edits and saves work correctly
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. An admin card is available for editing.
steps: Edit permissions for an admin - add 'Analytics' - Save
Immediately edit again - add 'Content Management' - Save
Observe the final state on the admin card
expectedResults: Each save operation completes successfully
The final admin card shows the correct cumulative result
No race conditions or data corruption occurs
Each edit starts with the latest saved state
testCases.postconditions: Multiple sequential edits produce correct final state

testCases.title: Permissions update is reflected in search and filter results
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. An admin's permissions have been updated.
steps: Edit an admin's permissions and save
Use the search to find that admin
Verify the updated permissions are shown in search results
Apply a role filter and verify the admin card shows updated permissions
expectedResults: Search results show the admin with updated permissions
Filtered views also reflect the updated permissions
The change is consistent across all views of the admin card
testCases.postconditions: Permission updates are consistent across all views

testCases.title: Edit permissions for admin on page 2 (pagination)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Admin list has multiple pages.
steps: Navigate to page 2 of the admin list
Click 'Edit Permissions' on an admin card on page 2
Observe the admin card on page 2
expectedResults: The permissions editor opens correctly for admins on page 2
Save works correctly
The admin card on page 2 updates with new permissions
User remains on page 2 after save (not redirected to page 1)
testCases.postconditions: Edit works correctly on paginated pages
